question: When do broker acknowledgement, redelivery and an application receipt establish sufficient local completion?
technology_configuration: actual SQLite message/effect/receipt state with authored broker/channel/redelivery model; no RabbitMQ/AMQP product execution
baseline: same-information qualified/reference procedures with conventional native mechanisms credited
risk_effectiveness: registered per-case I/M/P/Ø predicates; no population probability
business_value: A team can distinguish transport progress from fulfilled business work and identify which local effect/receipt obligations prevent loss or duplication.
residual_limits: Publisher confirmation, delivery acknowledgement and business completion have different boundaries. Local atomicity does not establish distributed exactly-once or broker product reliability.
delivery: scoped research report/dossier complete; commissioned six-output delivery not implied
